title: Infiltration
description: Stalleo, a wizard camped outside Treva's Watch, asks the player to infiltrate the fort through a secret tunnel and open the front gate from inside so he can reclaim his home from the bandits who seized it and kidnapped his family.

base_facts: I am a wizard camped outside Treva's Watch with my bodyguards.
Invaders took my fort and kidnapped my family while we were away fighting in the war.
There is a secret escape tunnel that leads into Treva's Watch from the outside.
I need someone to enter through the tunnel and open the front gate from inside so my bodyguards and I can retake the fort.

BEAT_ACCEPT_QUEST: A mercenary has agreed to help me infiltrate Treva's Watch and open the gate.
BEAT_ENTER_TUNNEL: The mercenary has entered the secret tunnel and is fighting through the bandits inside the fort.
BEAT_OPEN_GATE: The front gate has been opened from inside. I can now enter the fort with my bodyguards.
BEAT_COMPLETE: The fort has been reclaimed from the bandits, though my family was not found inside. I hope they escaped. I gave the mercenary a Spell Tome: Detect Life as a reward.
Player reports to Stalleo after opening the gate. Quest completes; reward is Spell Tome: Detect Life.
Dispatch them and climb the stairs to find a short ramp ahead leading up to a somewhat crooked hallway.
After passing through a medium-sized room containing more smithing materials, you will reach a spiral staircase leading upwards into the fort's tower.

beats.comment: Player talks to Stalleo and agrees to infiltrate Treva's Watch through the secret tunnel.
Player has entered the secret tunnel and is working through Treva's Watch interior.
Player has pulled the lever and opened the front gate from inside Treva's Watch.
Player reports to Stalleo after opening the gate. Quest completes; reward is Spell Tome: Detect Life.
